guideline: Systematic analysis and categorization of failure cases for visual prompts in medical VQA
Systematic analysis and categorization of failure cases for visual prompts in medical VQA

- To better understand these failure cases, we conducted a systematic analysis and categorized the underlying causes of errors into the following types: First, we found that some visual prompts were too small or used colors that were not easily perceived by the model... Secondly, for certain counting questions, the number of visual prompts provided can occasionally be misleading... Thirdly, visual prompts can mislead the model into providing incorrect answers to questions regarding the existence of abnormalities... Finally, the model can sometimes rely on the location of visual prompts when answering location-related questions.
